The '''Fromm Gang''', also known as the '''Fromm Family of Crime''', was a long-lived [[Annoo-dat Blue|Annoo-dat]] criminal family, based on [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Annoo]]. The Fromm Gang maintained a legitimate import/export business as a front for extortion, kidnapping and [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] smuggling.

==History==
[[File:Fromm_family.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Sise Fromm and Vlix Oncard]]
During the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Fromm Gang was led by [[Sise Fromm]]. Sise and his assistant, [[Vlix Oncard]], were distrustful of technology, preferring to rely on organic muscle, including numerous [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] guards.<ref name="EIT book">[[Escape Into Terror (book)|''Escape Into Terror'' picture book]]</ref> However, Sise's younger son, [[Tig Fromm|Tig]], felt that technology was the future of the gang. He persuaded his father to invest in a number of wild power gambles, most notably the development of the weapons satellite ''[[Trigon One]]'', in order to overthrow the other gangs.<ref name="EIT">{{DroidsCite|Escape Into Terror}}</ref>

The ''Trigon One'' was stolen by [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]], [[Jord Dusat]] and [[Kea Moll]] acting on behalf of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|resistance cell]] on Annoo. When Sise Fromm kidnapped Dusat and [[Demma Moll|Kea's mother]], Joben revealed where he had hidden ''Trigon One'' in exchange for their release. Tig Fromm went to retrieve ''Trigon One'', but Joben and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] had sabotaged the guidance system, causing the ship to collide with and destroy [[Sise Fromm's stronghold]] on Annoo.<ref name="TTU">{{DroidsCite|The Trigon Unleashed}}</ref>

The debacle had brought the Fromms' actions to the attention of the other gang leaders, and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] placed a large bounty on the leaders of the gang. After one final attempt to get revenge on Joben and the others at the [[Boonta Speeder Race]], Sise Fromm, Tig Fromm and Vlix Oncard were captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who turned them over to Jabba for the reward.<ref name="ARTTF">{{DroidsCite|A Race to the Finish}}</ref>

However, the Fromm Gang eventually ended up released by Jabba via a bribe from the crime family. As part of the deal to spare their lives, the Fromms agreed to donate a large percentage of their business profits and commit their army of [[Annoo-dat]] clones to take out the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] diaspora that had encroached on the Hutt's territory.<ref name="TDRA2" />

At some point following their release, the Fromm Gang encountered the droids again, when the gangsters attempted to steal a nuclear-powered missile blueprint from [[Kea Moll]].<ref name="TSD">{{StoryCite|story=The Secret Disk|book=MyComyc|bformatted=''MyComyc'' 6}}</ref> Later, the Fromms built an artificial cloud device and used it to ambush spacers. A ship carrying C-3PO and R2-D2 was captured, and the droids infiltrated the Fromm vessel, deactivating the device and escaping.<ref name="TC">{{StoryCite|story=The Cloud|book=MyComyc|bformatted=''MyComyc'' 7}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Annoo-dat members of the Fromm Gang were all depicted as identical in [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars Droids'']]. The [[Escape Into Terror (book)|picture book adaptation]] of the episode "[[Escape Into Terror]]" confirms that Sise Fromm's guards are clones.
